items.title: Guarani (MG) Health & medical procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 8 #112
items.en_title: Guarani (MG) Health & medical procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 8 #112
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Guarani (MG) is procuring healthcare goods or services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 655,336; proposals close Dec 8, 16:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
